messages: maya: FYI the docs build failed on staging after we swapped the mkdocs theme. linkcheck flagged a bunch of anchor mismatches (old-style anchors vs new slugified ids). docs-bot: CI: docs/linkcheck pipeline failed (exit 1). 12 broken anchors found. Full log: . :x: olivia: The theme change normalizes heading ids to include parent path tokens, so anchors like `#gpu-tiling` became `#guides-serving-gpu-tiling`. Some external pages still point to the old short anchors. maya: We need a fix that doesn't require editing every external link or 40+ internal docs. Any low-risk approaches? raj: Two options: 1) Add compatibility anchors into generated html (post-build) that preserve the old ids. 2) Generate an _anchor-redirects.html_ page with tags and deploy it where linkcheck looks. Post-build injection is straightforward. olivia: Prefer post-build injection in the build pipeline. Keep source untouched. We should also auto-generate the mapping by parsing the mkdocs nav + headings so it's future-proof. tony: I sketched a small Go tool yesterday that parses each page and writes shim anchors for the old ids. But a simple Python script will be faster to land. maya: Can someone open a PR with the post-build script + CI change? Add a unit test and a short note in the migration guide. raj: I'll open the PR. Plan: branch docs/anchor-compat-179950. Add scripts/docs_inject_anchors.py, tests/test_inject_anchors.sh, and CI step after mkdocs.build to run injection and then linkcheck against the injected site. The script will read a generated map file anchors_map.csv with lines: old_id,new_id,page.html so it's decoupled. olivia: Make the script idempotent and safe for multiple runs (don't duplicate anchors). Also add a small check that prevents injecting anchors into files >5MB to avoid weird pages. raj: Agreed. Here's the script logic in pseudo: ```python # read anchors_map.csv # for each (old,new,page): open page, if 'id="{old}"' not present then insert `` before element with id new # write back file atomically ``` maya: Good. Also please include a tiny grep-based sanity check to find remaining references to old anchors in docs/ and in the changelog page. We'll want to update the changelog link once this merges. tony: After PR merges I can run a preview build on canary and run the full linkcheck including locales. I'll coordinate with infra for a quick preview. olivia: One more thing: add a short blurb in docs/migration/theme-migration.md saying we now preserve legacy anchor ids via build shim and list how to opt out if someone intentionally renames anchors. raj: Opening PR now. Assigning olivia + maya as reviewers. Draft description includes risk assessment and rollback plan (remove post-build step). docs-bot: PR opened by raj: 44d linkcheck job queued. maya: Thanks all. After we merge let's watch the next week of external link failures closely, but this should stop the immediate churn. olivia: :thumbsup: Small follow-up: can we add a test case with a page that had a manually-written anchor to ensure we don't clobber existing ids? raj: Will do. I'll add test fixtures and make the script skip injection if the old id already exists. tony: LGTM. Standing by for preview.
